t: The Forge Steel 216-Piece Mixed Drive Socket Set is an essential collection for mechanics, DIY enthusiasts, and general maintenance tasks. This comprehensive set features 1/4", 3/8" and 1/2" drive sockets, including standard and deep sizes, E-profile sockets, spark plug sockets, combination spanners, hex keys, and a wide variety of precision bits. All tools are heat-treated, chrome plated, hardened and tempered for durability and corrosion resistance. The 6-point head design ensures a secure grip on fasteners. Supplied in a robust blow-moulded case, this versatile socket set is ideal for daily repairing and automotive work.
b: Corrosion-Resistant Finish Protects Tools from Rust & Wear
